トラック名をファイル名にした個別WAVをZIPにまとめます。ファイル名の末尾で、: Bundles individual WAVs named after each track into a ZIP. The filename suffix distinguishes SoundFont-rendered audio (_midi) from the original sound (_orig). Hardware sounds that can't be separated, such as noise/DPCM or DAC, end up combined into a single WAV. Splitting the original sound by channel takes longer, since the whole song is re-emulated once per channel.
